statement: Russell Brand receives a total custodial term of at least 10 years at his sentencing between 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-10.
resolution: TRUE if the sentence imposed at Southwark Crown Court between 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-10, per judiciary.uk remarks or two of BBC, Reuters and AP, totals 10 or more years in custody.
failure_condition: Brand is not sentenced between 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-10, or the total custodial term imposed is under 10 years.

statement: The CISA KEV catalog carries a date-added value between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-04 for CVE-2026-107441, the Zyxel GS1900 out-of-bounds write flaw.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV JSON feed lists CVE-2026-107441 with a dateAdded value between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-04.
failure_condition: CVE-2026-107441 has no KEV entry with a date-added value between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-04.

statement: A federal court order barring construction of the Trump arch at Memorial Circle, entered between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-04, is in force and unstayed on 2026-12-04.
resolution: TRUE if the D.D.C. docket in the arch cases before Judge Chutkan shows an injunction or restraining order against construction, entered between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-04, in force on 2026-12-04 and not stayed on appeal.
failure_condition: On 2026-12-04 no court order barring arch construction at Memorial Circle is in force, because none was entered or it expired, was dissolved or was stayed.

statement: The FOMC raises the upper bound of the federal funds target range to at least 4.25 percent at its meeting of 2026-12-08 to 2026-12-09. Reference: 4.00 percent on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if FRED series DFEDTARU reads 4.25 or higher on 2026-12-10, following the FOMC decision of 2026-12-09. Reference: 4.00 percent on the packet date.
failure_condition: The upper bound of the federal funds target range stays at or below 4.00 percent after the FOMC decision of 2026-12-09.

statement: US forces carry out at least one air or missile strike on Iranian territory, including Iranian islands, between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-11.
resolution: TRUE if CENTCOM or the Pentagon acknowledges, or two of Reuters, AP and BBC report citing US officials, a US strike on Iranian land or islands dated between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-11.
failure_condition: No US air or missile strike hit Iranian land or islands between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-11.

statement: The Ukrainian Air Force reports a single overnight Russian attack of at least 500 drones and missiles combined between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-11.
resolution: TRUE if the Ukrainian Air Force tally, as carried by Reuters or AP, shows one overnight attack totaling 500 or more drones and missiles launched between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-11.
failure_condition: No single overnight Russian attack on Ukraine between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-11 totaled 500 or more drones and missiles launched.

statement: ICE Brent front-month futures settle at or above 110 dollars on at least one trading day between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-11. Reference: 96.85 dollars on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if any ICE Brent front-month daily settlement between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-11 is 110.00 dollars or higher. Reference: 96.85 dollars on the packet date.
failure_condition: Every ICE Brent front-month daily settlement between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-11 stays below 110.00 dollars.

statement: The Bank of England MPC raises Bank Rate above 4.00 percent at its decision of 2026-12-17. Reference: 4.00 percent on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if the Bank of England official Bank Rate series shows a rate above 4.00 percent effective 2026-12-17. Reference: 4.00 percent on the packet date.
failure_condition: Bank Rate remains at or below 4.00 percent after the MPC decision of 2026-12-17.

statement: The Knesset approves in a confidence vote a new government headed by Gadi Eisenkot between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if the Knesset record shows a confidence vote approving a government with Eisenkot as prime minister, held between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-31, confirmed by Reuters or AP.
failure_condition: No government headed by Eisenkot wins a Knesset confidence vote between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-31.

statement: The US Senate passes a joint or concurrent resolution directing the removal of US forces from hostilities against Iran between 2027-01-03 and 2027-02-26.
resolution: TRUE if a Senate.gov roll call dated between 2027-01-03 and 2027-02-26 records majority passage of a war powers resolution directing removal of US forces from hostilities against Iran.
failure_condition: The Senate does not pass any war powers resolution on hostilities against Iran between 2027-01-03 and 2027-02-26.
